title: ConditionalBranchSubschemaShapes
description: The neighbouring spellings of an if/then/else sub-schema, one group per allOf branch so that a document naming one trigger exercises that group and no other. Every group is written on an allOf branch rather than on the root, because a branch's group is merged into the same struct and has to be read there as well. No group here states a per-property keyword: at the time it was written a branch's `properties` were merged into the struct as fields whose own Go type and rules enforced them whatever the condition said, so no document could tell the conditional reading of one from the field's. That unconditional binding was issue #213's false rejection; conditional_only_property_positions.json is where the per-property half is asked now.
